intent: Use Pi-format custom providers through pi-ai for three protocols, discover endpoint models, and add searchable model selection and provider management. npm run check passed (751 lune-memory tests); Chrome interaction and CSP checks passed. Configuration load failures stop Dreaming; requests reject redirects; credential validation precedes writes.

findings.summary: 3 处：models.json 的 apiKey、provider headers 和 model headers 解析后未经 HTTP 值校验便进入 SDK。值含换行时，三个协议的错误消息都会原样包含完整凭据；Dreaming 转抛该消息，失败记录和页面可显示密钥。应在调用 SDK 前统一验证解析后的密钥及请求头，并返回不含凭据的错误。
findings.resolution: Resolved keys and provider/model/final request headers are validated before SDK calls with errors that omit secret values. Failed command diagnostics omit shell text. Regression: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/integration/custom-provider-composition.test.ts — 10/10 pass after 9 red cases on the original version; invalid secret/name cases issue zero endpoint requests.

findings.summary: 2 个方向：native_endpoints 触发 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 协议互换时只写入 model.api，模型仍继承原协议的 baseUrl。OpenAI /v1 基址切到 Anthropic 后请求 /v1/v1/messages；Anthropic 主机基址切到 OpenAI 后请求 /responses，缺少 /v1。扫描成功后这些模型无法正常调用，应同时生成匹配新协议的模型级 baseUrl。
findings.resolution: Scanned model entries crossing OpenAI and Anthropic protocols now carry the matching model-level baseUrl and preserve the gateway prefix. The new integration suite proves scan → persistence → successful completion at /gateway/v1/messages and /gateway/v1/chat/completions; the same-family Responses route remains green.

findings.summary: Two exported helpers this change adds are never called: `streamsForApi` here (compose.ts dispatches through its own `streams[model.api]` lookup) and `isConfigValueConfigured` at config-value.ts:129. Nothing in src/, test/ or ui/ references either name.
findings.resolution: Removed the unused streamsForApi and isConfigValueConfigured exports and the unused Api type import; no caller depended on them. Relevant focused tests: 174 pass; package eslint and tsc pass.

findings.summary: `provider list` interpolates `provider.api` and `provider.baseUrl` unguarded. A custom provider that sets `api`/`baseUrl` per model (valid Pi format, and what a scan's native_endpoints override produces) is listed as `acme: null null, 1 models, no key`, although docs/reference.md:179 promises the protocol and URL.
findings.resolution: provider list labels absent top-level fields as protocol per model / URL per model. A direct CLI main probe using a valid model-level-only configuration returned the expected line without null. Reference documentation now explains the labels.
